typography.guidelines: Plus Jakarta Sans for all UI type. Tight tracking on the Northstar wordmark. Do not use Manrope, IBM Plex, or Cicle-like mono labels on chrome.

colors.archetype: Ink workspace — charcoal sidebar, indigo accent, cool gray board, hairline cards

specific_adjustments.sidebar_text_active: #EEF0FF on indigo fill #2A3170 with 2px indigo inset bar
specific_adjustments.task_action_buttons: outline chips, not solid gray Cicle buttons

colors.guidelines: Never use forest green, warm yellow selection, or Cicle gray action stacks. Sidebar is always charcoal. Cards have a 1px border and no soft Cicle shadow. Selected nav is indigo, not yellow.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: Dense Ink board — hairline cards, compact chrome, metadata strip on task detail
spacing_and_layout.guidelines: Columns 272px with 8px radius and a hairline. Cards 14px padding, 8px radius, 1px border. Topbar 48px. Task modal is a single column with a horizontal property/action chip row under the title — never a right-hand gray button stack.

motion.guidelines: Every interactive element gets a targeted transition (never `transition: all`): buttons lift on hover and scale down slightly on press; tabs and nav items animate background/color; kanban cards, overview cards, and list rows fade+rise in on mount (`riseIn` keyframe); modals and dropdowns fade+scale in (`modalIn`); the unread notification dot pulses (`pulseDot`).

kanban_cards.guidelines: White cards, 1px line border, no default shadow. Hover lifts 2px. Overdue cards get a red strip and tint. Due chip is red when due today or past.

sidebar.guidelines: Charcoal sidebar, Northstar wordmark (4-point star + name), indigo active row. Never a yellow selected row.

topbar.guidelines: Breadcrumb: Beranda › tim › Papan. Tabs are indigo-tinted pills, not a black underline.

task_detail_modal.guidelines: Single column. Title, short crumb (list · team), metadata chips (people, dates, labels), then outline property/action chips. Panels open inline. No KELOLA TUGAS gray stack.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Do NOT touch or remove any existing `data-testid` attributes in the JS files.
2. Do NOT change the LABEL_COLORS swatch palette values (CreateTeamModal.jsx / TaskDetailModal.jsx) — they are embedded in generated data-testid strings.
3. All visual styling lives in App.css, extra.css, team.css and the font import in index.css — prefer editing those over adding inline styles or Tailwind classes to JSX.
4. Keep class names stable; only change declarations inside existing rules or add new rules for a genuinely new class.

5. Reuse the CSS custom properties defined in App.css :root (--paper, --surface, --ink, --muted, --line, --accent, --accent-hover, --accent-tint, --select, --column, --action, --action-hover, --success, --danger, --warning, --violet, --teal, --rose, --r-sm, --r-md, --r-lg, --font-heading, --font-body, --font-mono) instead of hardcoding new hex values.
6. Do not restyle back toward Cicle (forest green, yellow nav, gray action stack, IBM Plex/Manrope).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep cards sharp for dense data tools.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern, sharp button styles (e.g., 6px radius) with interaction animations for dashboard context.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
